title: The formal completion of a formal algebraic space along a closed subset is a formal algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For a formal algebraic space X over a scheme and a closed subset T of its reduction, the lemma asserts that the functor of morphisms from a scheme into X whose image lies in T is a formal algebraic space (statement lines 7996-8004). The proof first checks the sheaf condition, which is immediate from surjectivity of the induced map on underlying sets for an fppf covering (proof lines 8006-8010). It then chooses a presentation of X, observes that the base changes of the members of the presentation along the completion functor are etale over it and jointly surjective onto it, so that it suffices to treat the case where X is an affine formal algebraic space (proof lines 8012-8020). In that case a point of the base changed functor is identified as a morphism into an affine formal algebraic space whose image lies in the preimage of the closed subset under the reduction of the member of the presentation, which reduces the assertion to the statement that the completion of an affine formal algebraic space along a closed subset of its reduction is affine (proof lines 8020-8025). The claim is H2: the sheaf condition, the covering reduction, and the identification of the base changed functor are each carried out, with the final step being a named statement about the affine case.
